answer: Sharded collateral registries: new agents join verification pools - timber, violet, basalt - each demanding its own bond, peer attestation of distinct work, and a wait before voting. Weight comes from bonded stake and tenure, never key count. To build a sybil cluster, an attacker must fund every duplicate across all pools, win genuine attestations from unrelated peers, and accept slashing when a clone is flagged. Costs grow linearly with identities; influence cannot outpace honest agents accumulating tenure. Fake identity becomes a capital-intensive, reversible bet.
